summary:
The selected current-only source completes one literal .104/utel-rel-22 successor through the existing publisher and protected Authority journal. A strict release-specific suspension outside the original two-file journal binds the immutable .103 Unknown tuple, one successor and the source-owned accepted decision. The shared reader fences entry, credentials, journal/provider and intent/dispatch/settlement/recovery; missing or changed evidence refuses. Original Unknown and inherited reservations remain unresolved; source delivery does not install a disposition or settle an old effect.

An explicit install-only mode in the existing workflow closes writer custody without a new service or secret. Mutually exclusive jobs, closed inputs and exact native source/run/first-attempt/operator guards precede the existing Authority-only App issuer. Available reader and scoped writer remain distinct. Relevant untracked import files refuse clean-source admission. Protected expected-parent creation, retained original request/Unknown and independent readback preserve old and unrelated bytes. Installation cannot enter publication or automatically continue into it; actual reader/issuer capability and cleanup remain native gates.

The ordinary .104 forward caller now continues bounded independent observation within one invocation, retaining the original objects, counter, deadline and no-resend policy. Historical selections retain their own semantics. Reuse is confined to validated immutable Git objects and two distinct local fresh CAS sandwiches: one before object creation, another after it immediately before PATCH. No mutable observation crosses mutation, wait or effect. Main/source/run/protection and disposition predicates remain fresh; post-write readback remains independent. Earlier single-invocation controls exhausted1500 and remain evidence. The complete real-provider synthetic control with final original/sibling verification records1439 Authority entries over33 advances/16 sends/16 settlements/80 virtual waiting seconds. The nominal61-entry margin is not native latency or whole-job feasibility, and delays may still checkpoint. The1500 ceiling, quota floor1800,45-minute deadline and152-advance maximum are unchanged; no new workflow or automatic replay is introduced.

Source version .104 is not publication, journal allocation or updater activation. Exact unused coordinates/predecessor/feed/tag gates, live competing-entry/credential disposition, installed suspension, genuine final candidate identity, native whole-job fit, publication/readback and actual installed V2/private-credential/UI/consumer acceptance remain separate. No missing original artifacts or historical binding are reconstructed.
title: Current .104 source completes prospective suspension and bounded continuation
